name: Encore Tracker
description: Per-user Encore playback sync for Jellyfin.
overview: Connect each Jellyfin user to their own Encore account and sync watch history. Minimum Jellyfin version: 10.10.7.

versions.changelog: Repair per-user Encore pairing persistence and auth flow, add plugin-side diagnostics visibility, and stabilize scrobble/backfill behavior for Jellyfin 10.10.7+.
